story.fullStory:
Benny Blanco, Tainy, Selena Gomez's "I Can't Get Enough" reached #66 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Can't Get Enough" is an English-Spanish song by American record producer Benny Blanco, Puerto Rican record producer Tainy, American singer Selena Gomez, and Colombian singer J Balvin.

The song peaked at #66 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 5 weeks on the chart.

I Can't Get Enough was released in 2019.
